about: What a Reference or a name reads: names beyond the extent, unknown functions, Sheet qualifiers, and a multi-cell Reference as a result (ADR-0046/0047).

cases.description: A name outside the extent is not a Reference; an unknown name is #NAME?
A name outside the extent is not a Reference; an unknown name is #NAME?
A function outside the declared set is #NAME?, whatever its arguments
A function outside the declared set is #NAME?, whatever its arguments
A function outside the declared set is #NAME? (IRR is not declared)
cases.engineDiffersByDecision: ADR-0047: a function outside the declared set is #NAME?; IRR is not admitted yet

cases.description: A Reference qualified with another Sheet's name names no cell
cases.engineDiffersByDecision: ADR-0046: one Sheet; a Reference qualified with any other Sheet's name names no cell and is #REF!

cases.description: The Sheet qualifier is recorded as typed
A multi-cell Reference as a Formula's result spills (ADR-0125), or is #SPILL! past the Sheet's edge

A one-cell range is that cell's Value
An absolute Reference reads the cell

A Reference to a refused cell in a branch not taken refuses the Formula, as one to a cycle makes it #CIRC!: B1 is MROUND(6.05,0.1), refused, which Excel answered 6 (MROUND-001); what IF(TRUE,1,B1) gives is asked. Excel answers 1 (the oracle run of 2026-10-18), the difference by decision
cases.engineDiffersByDecision: ADR-0047 (2026-10-12, decided with the user: a refusal is never caught, anywhere): MROUND's fractional multiple is refused (ADR-0047), and a Formula whose text names a refused cell is refused whether or not the branch naming it is taken, as #CIRC! is (ADR-0047)
